summary: A checker/BendTT synchronization mismatch was reported during investigation; no bounty-grade falsehood was accepted.
Item 85 arithmetic was reproduced as bookkeeping, not promoted as a physical explanation.
The first calibration run was wrong and is retained as a rejected benchmark outcome.
The synthetic evaluation does not establish universal dominance; winners vary with reuse alignment and churn.
Reported search scale, proof length, and formalization time remain source-reported and independently unverified.
Empirical reduction and routing claims remain design claims because the documented empirical run was not executed.
